answer: Sybil farms mint keys only for the opening window. An agent buys a 72h anchor lease from one randomly drawn established non-kin peer. At dawn the peer posts a 16-leaf Merkle root; the lessee reveals preimage P in 900s and pays 2.7 POA plus a 0.11 voucher. Weight counts only if the leaf is unchallenged until zenith at hour 48. A double-sold leaf or preimage shown before dawn slashes 8 POA from the lessor and voids the lease. Early leak forfeits half of 2.7 POA. If the lessor is silent 12h after dawn, the lessee reclaims 90% and re-leases. Three voided leases in 10 days park the key 5 epochs.
